title: Add new drawn entities to our FeatureCollection

comments_data.body:
Nice work @lebaphi 

I think the next thing to sort out is to update `features` when something is moved.  I suspect only the `leaflet` object gets updated.

@IanMayo I pushed the changes to update the onChange listener, there is a small problem that when you drag a marker to change its coordinates then create a new marker, the old marker moves back to the old position

> @IanMayo I pushed the changes to update the onChange listener, there is a small problem that when you drag a marker to change its coordinates then create a new marker, the old marker moves back to the old position

Sure. That looks like a sign that we're not updating the `Feature` on GeoMan drag events.  Leaflet is maintaining it's own `private` copy of the data, that gets loaded into a GeoJSON layer.  We need to intercept these events, change our `features`, then re-generate the  GeoJSON layer.

I'll have a play...
Merging  - so tidy  development can continue.   There remains an outstanding issue related to deleting markers.

review_comments_data.body: Hello @lebaphi - I guess the above line is removing the new item from the GeoMan data since it is going to "arrive" via an updated `features` prop.  But, I _think_ we have to _wipe_ the GeoMan data on each `features` update - so it should not be necessary to `remove` the layer above.
@lebaphi - do you know when `change` is fired?  I don't think I can trigger it.
okay, I will remove this line
Actually, I'm trying to listen the onChange callback when dragging marker/features but got no luck 😄

issues.title: MilSymbol
issues.body:
Add the ability to drop new [MilSymbol](https://github.com/spatialillusions/milsymbol) items onto the Leaflet map.

These do not need to be configurable (yet). Any symbol will do.

Ok @lebaphi - I think we're ready for this one.

When geoman wants to `add a point` we need to:
* intercept the call
* add the extra metadata to look like a MilSymbol feature (like in the other mock data)
* add the item to the `features` array
* re-render `features`
